adopt: Open a lease with a one-dollar cap and a thirty-minute expiry, run one job under it, and watch the charge that would cross the cap be refused.
description:
Kind: runtime

Problem
Spare compute is everywhere (idle gaming GPUs, free CI minutes, spot boxes, edge workers), but handing a contributor a slice of shared budget means trusting them not to overspend, remembering to switch it off, and finding out later whose bill it silently landed on.

Install
pip install awedgerunner

Commands
  awedgerunner

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awedgerunner/
synopsis: Run agent and CI work on edge runners nobody has to rack -- a volunteer's idle GPU, a phone on your own mesh, an edge worker, a free or spot CI runner -- under a lease with a hard budget cap, a named payer and an expiry.
